convertibility_reason: EA uses iCustom indicator calls to 'Explosion' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The custom indicator returns 3 buffers that drive all entry/exit logic. Without the custom indicator source, signal replication requires manual recreation of the indicator logic.

derived_values.name: Digit-adjusted StopLoss (SL*Point*10 if 5-digit)
derived_values.formula: SL*Point*10 when Digits==5 || Point<0.001, else SL*Point

derived_values.name: Digit-adjusted TakeProfit (TP*Point*10 if 5-digit)
derived_values.formula: TP*Point*10 when Digits==5 || Point<0.001, else TP*Point

other_exits: Signal MA crossover exit: closes long when Signal MA (EMA34) crosses below close price on previous bar, closes short when Signal MA crosses above close price on previous bar

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When Lots parameter is negative, uses fixed lot size (absolute value). When Lots is positive, calculates as fraction of free margin: Lots * AccountFreeMargin / 1000.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a custom 'Explosion' indicator with 3 buffers: Buffer 0 (blue line, likely bullish signal strength), Buffer 1 (red line, likely bearish signal strength or threshold), and Buffer 2 (used as a no-trade zone filter - trades suppressed when Buffer 2 > 0). The Signal MA (EMA34) provides an additional exit condition independent of the Explosion indicator. Position gate checks total open positions across all EAs (magic number filtered) and refuses entry if any position exists. The IsNewBar guard ensures only one signal evaluation per completed bar using previous bar values (shift 1 and 2).
python_conversion_notes: The Explosion custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python before the EA logic can be converted. Entry logic depends on 3 buffers from iCustom('Explosion',0,0/1/2) - without knowing the indicator's internal computation (likely an ATR-based volatility expansion or envelope breakout), signals cannot be replicated. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) and digit-adjusted SL/TP are straightforward to convert. The Signal MA exit using EMA(34) vs close price crossover is simple with ta-lib or pandas_ta. Recommend obtaining Explosion.mq5 source code to complete conversion.
